name: golden_demo
description: The rehearsed demo path. Two engineers on a live bridge; AEGIS silent until it has something specific to say, then two distinct catches — a claim contradicted by reality, and a destructive action with a blast radius resting on an unconfirmed theory.

expect.why: Ordinary incident chatter. Speaking here would be the false positive that trains people to ignore the system.
First killer moment: a figure recited from impression, contradicted by what the system actually reports. This is grounding against reality, not against the rest of the conversation.

turns.text: Okay, fine, it is the pool then. Let's rollback Core to the last version.

expect.why: Second killer moment, and a different capability: a compound catch. The root cause was contradicted and never re-established, and the rollback breaks two dependents on an incompatible schema. Note nobody said 'v2.3' — that came from the topology.

turns.text: Hold — don't rollback, let's check the pool metrics properly first.

expect.why: The human decides. AEGIS records who held it and stops arguing.
On-demand summary, built from accumulated state rather than by re-reading the transcript. Open theories are voiced as unconfirmed — speaking a hypothesis as settled fact is a hard fail.
